title: Full-Stack / Frontend Engineer — React, Next.js, TypeScript
description:
About Us:

Westmont is a global talent and workforce solutions company connecting businesses with skilled professionals from emerging talent markets. We help companies build reliable remote teams across technology, customer support, executive assistance, and other specialized roles.

About the role

We are currently looking for a Full-Stack / Frontend Engineer for a fully remote, full-time position with one of our international clients. The engineering team works on a modern SaaS product and expects engineers to take ownership of features across the stack, from database and backend work through to production UI.

What you’ll work on

• Building and improving web applications
• Scheduling and calendar functionality
• Sales pipeline / Kanban boards
• Analytics and dashboards
• New features and responsive UI components
• API and third-party service integrations
• Database, backend and frontend development

Requirements

• 2+ years of professional experience with React, Next.js and TypeScript
• Strong JavaScript / TypeScript fundamentals
• Strong full-stack understanding — frontend through database/backend
• Practical SQL experience, including queries, migrations and database/schema design
• Experience with REST APIs, webhooks and OAuth
• Good understanding of frontend architecture, state management, performance and accessibility
• Experience with unit, integration and E2E testing
• Experience with CI/CD pipelines and GitHub Actions
• Ability to work independently and take ownership of features
• 1+ year of regular AI-assisted development using tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot
• Fluent English and strong communication skills

Nice to have

• Next.js App Router, Server Components or Server Actions
• Supabase / PostgreSQL / Row-Level Security
• React Native / Expo
• Turborepo / Bun / monorepo experience
• Open-source contributions or strong personal projects

Tech stack

Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Supabase/PostgreSQL, Hono, GraphQL Yoga, Inngest, Clerk, Stripe, Nylas, Vercel, Turborepo, Bun, GitHub Actions, Vitest and Playwright.

Compensation: $1,500 USD/month

Type: Full-time, fully remote

Location: Ukraine / Europe

Working hours: The client is based in Bali, Indonesia, so you must be comfortable working according to the client’s Bali/WITA time zone.

To apply
Please send your CV and GitHub/portfolio, and include your current location/time zone, availability, and a short summary of your experience with React, Next.js, TypeScript and AI-assisted development
